combo_tournament_winners.label: Combination tournament-winner markets
combo_tournament_winners.target: Joint outcome of several tournament winners.

exact_set_score.label: Exact set score and match score
exact_set_score.target: Exact final set score (2-0, 2-1, 3-0, 3-1, 3-2) or exact match set pattern.

game_winner_inplay.label: In-play game winner
game_winner_inplay.target: Winner of the current game given live score.

match_winner.label: Match winner
match_winner.target: Winner of the match, with retirement/walkover per contract wording.

nationality_and_team_futures.label: Nationality and team-competition futures
nationality_and_team_futures.target: Whether any player from a nation wins / the count reaching a stage / team advancement or title.

player_aces_and_double_faults.label: Player aces and double faults
player_aces_and_double_faults.target: Aces or double faults by a player in the match relative to a strike.

retirement_walkover_participation.label: Retirement, walkover and participation
retirement_walkover_participation.target: Whether a player participates, withdraws, retires or announces a decision within a window.

season_ranking_and_majors.label: Season ranking, majors and qualification
season_ranking_and_majors.target: Season-end ranking, number of majors, or qualification for a season finals.

set_and_game_spreads.label: Set and game spreads
set_and_game_spreads.target: Game or set differential of a player relative to a handicap line.

set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events.label: Set sweep and tiebreak-occurs events
set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events.target: Whether a player wins all sets, or whether any tiebreak occurs.

set_winner_and_any_set.label: Set winner and any-set markets
set_winner_and_any_set.target: Winner of a named set or whether a player wins at least one set.

total_games_and_sets.label: Total games and total sets
total_games_and_sets.target: Total games or sets in the match relative to a strike.

tournament_winner_futures.label: Tournament winner and round-reached futures
tournament_winner_futures.target: Winner, round reached, or round of elimination in a tournament.
